name: Nanzuka
about_text: NANZUKA is a contemporary art gallery in Tokyo, founded by Shinji Nanzuka in 2005 in Shibuya as Nanzuka Underground, originally in a basement near Shibuya Crossing. The gallery focuses on rediscovering Japanese artists who were overlooked in the postwar fine-art scene, such as pop-art pioneer Keiichi Tanaami and airbrush illustrator Harumi Yamaguchi, while also promoting emerging Japanese talent and select international artists internationally. NANZUKA frequently collaborates with the fashion, music and design industries, expanding notions of what constitutes fine art. In 2021 it relocated its main space to a dedicated building in Harajuku and also runs satellite project spaces, Nanzuka 2G and 3110NZ. From 2013 to 2024 it operated a joint-venture branch in Hong Kong, AISHONANZUKA.

ABOUT: NANZUKA is a contemporary art gallery in Tokyo, established by Shinji Nanzuka in 2005 in Shibuya under the name Nanzuka Underground, originally housed in a basement space near Shibuya Crossing. The gallery is dedicated to rediscovering Japanese artists overlooked in the postwar fine-art scene, including pop-art pioneer Keiichi Tanaami and airbrush illustrator Harumi Yamaguchi, while also promoting emerging Japanese talent and select international artists on the global stage. NANZUKA regularly collaborates with fashion, music and design industries to expand the boundaries of "fine art." In 2021 the gallery relocated its main space to a dedicated building in Harajuku, and it also runs satellite project spaces (Nanzuka 2G, 3110NZ). From 2013–2024 it operated a Hong Kong branch, AISHONANZUKA, jointly with Aisho Miura Arts.
